title: Users
subtitleAdmin: Panel accounts: administrators, resellers and customers.

empty.description: Start by creating a new account.

noPasswordTitle: No password set — this account cannot log in until you assign one.

createModal.usernameHint: 3-32 characters, starts with a lowercase letter; may contain letters, digits, _ and -.
createModal.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. The password is shown only now — hand it to the user.
createModal.resellerOnlyCustomers: Resellers can create customer accounts only.

passwordModal.title: Set Password
passwordModal.customerNote: This is the customer's panel account password. The customer signs in at the customer portal with this username and password; without one the account cannot log in.

limitsModal.title: Reseller Limits
limitsModal.unlimitedNote: 0 = unlimited. If all are 0 the limit record is removed entirely.
limitsModal.noLimit: No limit is defined for this reseller — currently unlimited.
limitsModal.loweringNote: Lowering a limit below current usage does not delete existing accounts; it only blocks new additions.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.resellerNote: Accounts beneath this reseller are not deleted; they are transferred to the administrator.
